text: lia (product): Heads-up from customer call: they want to reorder columns in compare and pin multiple models at once for rule-based deployments. Also asked for a CSV export to keep audit trails. anya (design): Reordering is fine. Two UX choices: drag-and-drop headers or a compact column menu with checkboxes + reorder arrows. Drag is more direct but less discoverable. sam (frontend): Drag is doable but needs a11y fallback. Column-menu approach is simpler to implement and plays nicer with virtualization. We can animate reflow less to avoid repaints. matt (eng): Animations will hurt perf with large tables. If we do drag, we should snapshot layout and do transform-based moves. Otherwise stick to the menu. dave (data): For CSV export, what fields should we include? Customers want model id, version, pinned_scope, p95_latency_ms, unit_cost_usd, last_deployed_by, and note. Also a timestamp for the export. lia (product): Include user who exported for audit. Add a column for "pin_reason" if available. Make CSV generation server-side to avoid client timeouts. anya (design): For bulk pinning, propose a small persistent multi-select toolbar when checkboxes selected: actions -> Pin selected, Unpin selected, Export selected. Pin should open a tiny modal to choose scope (global/route/workspace) and optional note. amanda (a11y): Modal must be keyboard-first. Ensure when it opens focus goes to the first input and aria-modal is true. Announce "Pin dialog opened for N models". For bulk actions, offer ARIA live updates like "3 models pinned". sam (frontend): Keyboard selection: support Shift+click range selection and Space to toggle focused row. Those are standard patterns. We should show a visible selection bar at the top with count. matt (eng): Backend bulk pin API should accept model_version_ids[] + scope + note. We should rate-limit by batch size; suggest 200 max per request and queue rest. dave (data): Add analytics events: bulk_pin_initiated, bulk_pin_completed, export_csv. Include metrics for duration and failure counts. lia (product): Microcopy debate: dialog CTA should read "Pin N models" vs "Apply pin". Which is clearer? anya (design): "Pin N models" is explicit. Also add a secondary "Cancel" and tiny helper text: "Pinned models take effect immediately for the selected scope." sam (frontend): Also add optimistic UI: mark rows as pinned while backend processes. But show a spinner for rows still pending. amanda (a11y): Optimistic UI ok but ensure status changes are announced. "2 of 5 models pinned, 3 pending" via aria-live. Also provide an undo snackbar for 10s. lia (product): Undo is important for accidental bulk pins. Make undo both visible and keyboard actionable. matt (eng): We'll expose an undo endpoint backed by a short-lived tombstone record. ETA: next sprint. dave (data): For export, store a short metadata record so we can link audit logs to exports. Also log the actor and IP if possible. anya (design): Badges: users said the latency badge felt like a warning. Let's change shape to pill with label "p95" and micro text for ms. Use color tokens that aren't warning yellow. sam (frontend): Implemented as 120ms. Add sr-only "95th percentile latency" for screen readers. amanda (a11y): Good. Also provide reduced-motion variant for badge reveal. Respect prefers-reduced-motion. deploy-bot: nightly/build #2167 completed staging assets v3.20.1 deployed. :shipit: lia (product): Action items: 1) @anya mock bulk-toolbar + pin modal, 2) @sam prototype keyboard multi-select + menu fallback, 3) @matt bulk-pin API + undo endpoint, 4) @dave analytics & export schema, 5) @amanda run a11y checklist on modal & announcements. We'll sync in 48h with prototypes.
